The Panos Gourdoupis Quartet is a Utrecht-based modern jazz ensemble
performing original music. Rooted in the jazz tradition, the group blends
contemporary composition with interactive improvisation, drawing on
influences from post-bop to modern jazz. Inspired by artists such as Wayne
Shorter and Kurt Rosenwinkel, the quartet has developed a distinct sound
through close collaboration. Over the past year, they have performed in several
cities across the Netherlands, including Amsterdam, Rotterdam, The Hague,
and Utrecht, as well as in venues such as TivoliVredenburg. The quartet is
currently focused on performing their repertoire while preparing to record their
debut album.
